calls.video_title: The Electronic Signatures Market is one of the Smallest Industries for Investment | DOCU Stock News
calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $101 vs market $83; forward PE 15.9
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (first tracked call in calls.json; ranked a buying opportunity all year, last updated 26 Jun 2026) — still undervalued on DCF and PE, but conviction downgraded since the price has more than doubled from ~$40 to over $82 and is approaching fair value.
calls.base_case: E-signature market keeps growing toward ~90% of all signings; revenue per employee nearly doubled since 2019 ($250k to $463k) as AI lifts productivity.
calls.bull_case: Agentic AI has not killed the business; integrations with Slack and Google Gemini entrench DocuSign as the signature of choice; EPS growth 11-12% expected.
calls.bear_case: Market is small (under $100B annual spend) so growth is capped; analysts expect 14.7% EPS growth, above his 11-12% estimate; valuation nearly doubled from under 10x forward PE earlier in 2026.
